summary: perf(admin-panel): cache the Nx build sub-targets
description:
Because:

- The Nx upgrade moved the four fxa-admin-panel build steps into
  dependsOn targets with no cache settings, so Nx reran them on
  every build in CI and in start-services.sh.

This commit:

- Adds cache, inputs and outputs to build-css, build-react,
  build-ts-client and build-ts-server in the nx.targets block.

Closes FXA-14727
